sloka: ततो विसृज्य रुचिरं पुष्पकं कामगामि तत् ।विसर्जयित्वा गच्छेति स्वस्ति ते ऽस्त्विति च प्रभुः ।। ७.८२.१९ ॥
transliteration: tato visṛjya ruciraṁ puṣpakaṁ kāmagāmi tat ।visarjayitvā gaccheti svasti te 'stviti ca prabhuḥ ।। 7.82.19 ॥

translations.english: Then, the lord Rama dismissed that beautiful Pushpaka, which moved at will, saying "Go, and let there be welfare for you."
